subject: POC final readout & decision — Medbase Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@medbase.health>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medbase.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps + POC scoping

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of needs
- Low-latency document search and summarization for clinician notes (SLA target: p95 < 250ms for queries).
- Embedding-based retrieval with privacy controls (data must remain in your VPC during Private deployment).
- Cost target ~ $0.003 per 1k inference tokens for the primary workflow.

Proposed POC plan (high-level)
1) Success criteria: accuracy on retrieval+RAG eval set (target ROC-AUC >= 0.87), p95 latency < 250ms, and end-to-end UX demo that ingests 10k notes.
2) Timeline: 4-week trial: week 0 kickoff + infra, week 1 data onboarding, week 2 evaluation + perf tuning, week 3 final readout/demo.
3) Ownership: Redwood (Marcus) will provision the environment and run perf tuning; Medbase (Daniel) to provide de-identified dataset and a small eval set.
4) Decision step: final executive readout on week 4 to sign off go/no-go; commercial terms to follow based on outcome.

Attached: medbase_poc_plan_v2.xlsx (POC timeline & tasks) and medbase_success_criteria.docx (detailed metrics).

Please confirm owners and whether the timeline looks feasible. If you prefer, we can shift the readout to the following week to accommodate schedules.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@medbase.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medbase.health>
Cc: Samantha Rhodes <samantha.rhodes@medbase.health>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps + POC scoping

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. We agree with the goals and the overall plan. A few clarifications:

- Dataset: we'll provide 12k de-identified notes by EOD Monday. Priya will own the transfer (SFTP or Drive link).
- Latency: 250ms p95 is acceptable as a target, but we need a plan if production load increases by 3x. Can Redwood provide autoscaling options and cost estimates for that scenario?
- Compliance: we'll need SOC2 evidence and a list of where logs/audit trails are stored.

We'll confirm a finalist date for the readout. Week of July 13th works for our execs.

—Daniel
Director of Data Platforms
Medbase Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@medbase.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@medbase.health>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps + POC scoping

Hi Daniel —

Thanks — quick answers to your asks: 
- Autoscaling: Redwood Dedicated can be configured to autoscale with a reserve baseline + 2x burst. I'll include cost delta estimates in the POC dashboard.
- SOC 2: attaching the SOC 2 compliance packet and a short note on where logs are retained for Private deployments. (Attachment stub: SOC2-summary.pdf).

We'll also add an evaluation scenario that simulates 3x concurrent load during week 2 tuning.

Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery — POC timeline confirmation + final readout scheduling

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Updated plan based on Marcus' note and your availability: 
- Data transfer: Priya, please use the Drive folder we shared; contact me if you prefer SFTP.
- I'll schedule the kickoff for Monday 2026-06-28 at 10:00 PT. Marcus will provision the Dedicated environment during week 0.
- Final readout: propose Tuesday 2026-07-14 at 11:00 PT. Please confirm if that time works for your execs; if not, propose 2 alternative windows next week.

Attaching the updated agenda (medbase_final_readout_agenda.pdf). Also dropping the HubSpot deal link below for reference.

Next steps (owners)
- Redwood (Marcus): infra + perf tuning, autoscale test (week 2).
- Medbase (Daniel/Priya): dataset + eval labels (by 2026-06-22).
- Redwood (Rishi): commercial placeholder/term sheet to be ready after readout.

Cheers,
Marissa

Confirmed. We'll upload the de-identified notes to the Drive folder by COB tomorrow (2026-06-24). 11:00 PT on 2026-07-14 works for the readout. We'll also prepare a short exec summary for the review panel. 

One quick ask on success criteria: can you add a qualitative UX acceptance (clinician sign-off on summaries) to the list so we can use both metrics and user feedback to make the go/no-go?

Thanks,
